overview.title: Which service do you need?
overview.text: With more than 30 years experience, your satisfaction is guaranteed. Pick a service to see what it involves, or call or text and we will tell you.

services.title: Title Transfers
services.summary: Buying, selling, gifting or a name change.
services.text: When you buy or sell a vehicle, gift a car, or require a name change on a car title, you'll usually need to transfer the title. Contact us and we are happy to help with the process.
services.lead: A title transfer moves ownership of a vehicle from one name to another. We handle the paperwork at the counter so the new owner's name is on record.
services.imageAlt: A car seller and buyer shaking hands over a sale

covers.title: Buying or selling
covers.text: The transfer that follows a private sale, so the title moves into the buyer's name.

covers.title: Gifting a vehicle
covers.text: A car given to a family member or another person still goes through a transfer.

covers.title: Name changes
covers.text: A change of name on a car title is handled as a transfer as well.

questions.q: Do I owe sales tax on a private sale?
questions.a: Texans who buy a used vehicle from anyone other than a licensed vehicle dealer are required to pay motor vehicle sales tax of 6.25 percent on the purchase price or standard presumptive value.

services.title: Registration Renewal
services.summary: Renew your Texas registration on time.
services.text: The Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) requires all residents to renew their vehicle registration annually. It's important to renew on time to avoid fines.
services.lead: Texas registration runs a year at a time. Renew it with us and you walk out with the sticker rather than waiting on the mail.
services.imageAlt: Close-up of the rear of a car showing its plate area

covers.title: Annual renewal
covers.text: The yearly renewal the Texas DMV requires of all residents.

covers.title: Renewing on time
covers.text: Renewing before the deadline is what keeps you clear of fines.

services.title: Duplicate Titles
services.summary: Replace a lost, stolen or destroyed title.
services.text: If your Texas car title has been lost, stolen or destroyed, you'll need to get it replaced immediately. Contact us and we are happy to help with the process.
services.lead: A missing title stops a sale before it starts. We file for the replacement so there is a current Texas title in your name again.
services.imageAlt: A stack of paper files and a pen on an office table

covers.title: Lost titles
covers.text: A Texas title that has gone missing is replaced with a duplicate.

covers.title: Stolen or destroyed
covers.text: A title taken or ruined is replaced the same way, and it should be done right away.

services.title: Bonded Titles
services.summary: Proof of ownership when there is no title.
services.text: A bonded title, also known as a "Certificate of Title Surety", is a document that proves a person's ownership of a motor vehicle. Contact us and we are happy to help with the process.
services.lead: A bonded title is just a title with a "bonded" brand. It implies there is a surety bond attached to the title, and it promises you own your vehicle. It can be an option for people who have a vehicle with no title or a title with errors.
services.imageAlt: An older pickup truck parked outside

covers.title: Vehicles with no title
covers.text: A route to ownership when the vehicle came to you without a title.

covers.title: Titles with errors
covers.text: An option where the existing title carries errors that block a transfer.

covers.title: The bond amount
covers.text: If your documents are approved, you will be issued a letter stating the amount of the bond equal to 1½ times the value of the vehicle.

covers.title: A free quote first
covers.text: We quote the bond free of charge before you commit to anything.

questions.a: A bonded title is just a title with a "bonded" brand. It implies there is a surety bond attached to the title, and it promises you own your vehicle.

questions.q: How is the bond amount decided?
questions.a: The department will determine the value of the vehicle, and the bond is equal to 1½ times that value. The Standard Presumptive Value from the Texas DMV website is the primary source.

services.title: 30 Day and Temp Tags
services.text: Car registration officials can issue a 30-day temporary registration for personal vehicles subject to TX registration laws. Contact us and we are happy to help with the process.
services.lead: A temporary tag keeps a personal vehicle on the road legally while the rest of the paperwork catches up.
services.imageAlt: The view through a car windshield on an open road

covers.title: 30-day registration
covers.text: Temporary registration issued for personal vehicles subject to Texas registration laws.

services.title: Mechanic Liens
services.summary: A lien for labor and materials supplied.
services.text: A mechanic's lien is a security interest in the title to property for the benefit of those who have supplied labor or materials that improve the property. Contact us and we are happy to help with the process.
services.lead: A mechanic's lien secures the title against work already done, for the benefit of whoever supplied the labor or the materials.
services.imageAlt: A mechanic working on a car engine

covers.title: Labor supplied
covers.text: A security interest for those who have supplied labor that improves the property.

covers.title: Materials supplied
covers.text: The same interest covers materials put into the vehicle.

services.title: SPV Appraisals
services.summary: Standard presumptive value for sales tax.
services.text: Texans who buy a used vehicle from anyone other than a licensed vehicle dealer are required to pay motor vehicle sales tax of 6.25 percent on the purchase price or standard presumptive value (SPV). SPV applies wherever you buy the vehicle, in Texas or out of state.
services.lead: Standard presumptive value is the figure Texas uses to work out sales tax on a used vehicle bought from anyone other than a licensed dealer.
services.imageAlt: Rows of cars parked in a large lot

covers.title: 6.25 percent sales tax
covers.text: Motor vehicle sales tax of 6.25 percent is due on the purchase price or the standard presumptive value.

covers.title: In Texas or out of state
covers.text: SPV applies wherever you buy the vehicle, in Texas or out of state.

covers.title: Where the value comes from
covers.text: The Standard Presumptive Value from the Texas DMV website is the primary source.

about.title: Helping customers since 1972.
text: Texas Gulf Coast Auto Title has been helping customers since 1972, from the counter at 811 Houston Blvd in South Houston. Our goal is to provide fast friendly service at a low price.

Bonded titles are the part people find hardest, so we simplify the bonded title process and make it easy to understand and complete. The bond quote is free, and you can call or text 713-946-0006 to start one.
about.imageAlt: A Texas interstate highway in afternoon sun

values.title: Professionally qualified
values.text: High quality service on titles, registration and the bonded title process.

faqs.a: A bonded title is just a title with a "bonded" brand. It implies there is a surety bond attached to the title. A bonded title promises you own your vehicle, and can be an option for people who have a vehicle with no title or a title with errors.
If your documents are approved, you will be issued a letter stating the amount of the bond equal to 1½ times the value of the vehicle. The department will determine the value of the vehicle.

faqs.q: How is my vehicle's value decided?
faqs.a: The Standard Presumptive Value (SPV) from the Texas DMV website is used as the primary source.

faqs.q: Does a bond quote cost anything?
faqs.a: No. The bond quote is free. Call or text 713-946-0006 and we will quote it.

faqs.q: Can I reach you by text?
faqs.a: Yes. The same number takes calls and texts: 713-946-0006.

faqs.q: How often does Texas registration have to be renewed?
faqs.a: The Texas Department of Motor Vehicles requires all residents to renew their vehicle registration annually, and renewing on time is what avoids fines.
